title_zh: 决定分开处理咖啡豆与点心坚果

scenario.label_zh: 决定分开处理咖啡豆与点心坚果
scenario.goal_zh: 识别共用研磨机的食材残留问题，并决定用独立工具处理坚果

context_zh: 两人在家中准备咖啡和含杏仁的饼干，希望避免杏仁碎留在咖啡研磨机里。
author: author-phase11-a

sentences.speaker: Will
sentences.text: Can I grind a handful of almonds in your coffee grinder for the biscuits?

sentences.speaker: Esme
sentences.text: Please use the small food processor instead. I do not want bits of almond left in the coffee grinder.

sentences.speaker: Will
sentences.text: Of course. Is this the processor on the shelf?

sentences.speaker: Esme
sentences.text: Yes, that one. The clean bowl is beside it.

sentences.speaker: Will
sentences.text: Found it. I'll use this for the almonds and leave the grinder for the coffee beans.
